todaysEvents.delta: Up: CENTCOM launches new wave of strikes on Iran (Reuters, Jul 15), targeting cruise missile storage and launch sites on Greater Tunb Island in the Strait of Hormuz (NYT, ABC, Jul 15). Strikes continued through Jul 16-17, making it 6 consecutive days of US-Iran exchanges.

Up: Tehran warned it would target infrastructure across the region if Trump follows through on threats to attack power plants and bridges (The Hindu/Reuters, Jul 16). IRGC struck US airbase in Jordan with ballistic missiles in retaliation for American strikes near a children's cancer hospital in Iran.

todaysEvents.summary: US Navy hits tanker skirting blockade
todaysEvents.delta: Up: US Navy interdicted and struck a tanker attempting to breach the Hormuz blockade (WUNC/NPR, Jul 15), as enforcement of Trump's 20% cargo tribute order intensifies. Reuters analysis warns Trump threatens new Iran escalation, risking repeating old mistakes (Jul 16).

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.description: A diplomatic off-ramp remains highly unlikely after Trump's blockade and tribute order. No talks have materialized in the days since. Any resumption of negotiations would require Iran to accept both the blockade and the 20% cargo fee, which Tehran has already rejected. Brent would settle toward $85-95/bbl as risk premium partially deflates. Probability held at 10%.

scenarios.label: Stress
scenarios.description: Hormuz blockade continues with sporadic enforcement; Iranian strikes persist at a constrained tempo. US strikes on Greater Tunb Island and tanker interdictions signal sustained commitment. Brent trades $100-130/bbl, JKM surges toward $25-30/MMBtu, iTraxx Asia IG breaks 150bp. ASEAN importers face severe supply chain disruption.

scenarios.label: Tail
scenarios.description: Blockade regime entrenches; Iran escalates with regional infrastructure strikes as warned. US strikes intensify against strategic Iranian infrastructure, now including Greater Tunb Island. Iran's threat to target infrastructure across the Gulf if bridges/power plants are hit expands the conflict geography. Brent spikes $115-140+/bbl with sustained outages; JKM above $35/MMBtu; Asian credit markets dislocate. Probability maintained at 65%.
